findings.title: Division or modulo by zero
findings.explanation: This expression will raise a runtime exception.
findings.suggestion: Validate the divisor before performing the operation.

findings.title: Possible hard-coded secret
findings.explanation: Secrets stored directly in source code may leak through Git history, logs or screenshots.
findings.suggestion: Move secrets to environment variables or a secret manager and rotate any exposed credentials.

findings.title: Mutable default argument
findings.explanation: Mutable default values are shared between function calls and can cause unexpected state.
findings.suggestion: Use None as the default and create the list, dictionary or set inside the function.

findings.title: os.system() command execution
findings.explanation: Building shell commands from untrusted data may lead to command injection.
findings.suggestion: Prefer subprocess.run() with an argument list and shell=False.

findings.title: subprocess shell=True
findings.suggestion: Use shell=False and pass command arguments as a list.

findings.title: Possible hard-coded secret
findings.explanation: Secrets stored directly in source code may leak through Git history, logs or screenshots.
findings.suggestion: Move secrets to environment variables or a secret manager and rotate any exposed credentials.

findings.title: Use of eval()
findings.suggestion: Avoid eval() and validate structured input instead.

findings.title: Bare except block
findings.explanation: A bare except catches every exception, including errors that should usually be visible.
findings.suggestion: Catch only the specific exception types you expect.

findings.title: Direct innerHTML assignment
findings.explanation: Untrusted HTML content may lead to cross-site scripting.
findings.suggestion: Prefer textContent or sanitize trusted HTML.

findings.title: Trailing whitespace
findings.explanation: Trailing whitespace creates noisy Git diffs and reduces code cleanliness.

findings.title: None compared with == or !=
findings.explanation: Python convention uses identity checks when comparing with None.
